_comment: Coverage ratchet baseline (scripts/coverage_report.py --check). union_binding_*, cells_live and template_cell_liveness_bp may not DECREASE; dead_cells and never_evaluated_rules may not INCREASE. Update only after a deliberate, recorded improvement — never to clear a red gate. READ THIS BEFORE TRUSTING A GREEN: cells_live is the cell-coverage floor. template_cell_liveness_bp is a RATIO whose denominator shrinks with its numerator and dead_cells is declared-minus-live, so both can IMPROVE while coverage is destroyed — measured, deleting the b31/rich run loses 689 live cells while moving liveness 1285->1374bp and dead 55553->47123. Only cells_live and the binding-rule counts fail on that. Separately, every metric is a UNION over the portfolio x regime matrix recorded in provenance, so growing RUNS makes dead_cells RISE and template_cell_liveness_bp FALL by declaring cells no portfolio fills yet; on a matrix change --check reports the comparison as INVALID rather than as a regression, and the right response is to re-measure and bank the new matrix with the reason in _note — never to drop a portfolio so the old numbers fit again.

REGIME-BLIND, AND THAT WAS A DECISION, NOT A DEFAULT. The plan bullet specified two different precedence rankings (PS1/26 Table A2 ranks CIU above equity; COREP Annex II para 62's decision tree ranks equity above CIU) and warned against implementing one for both. That design was STRUCK: the tree's rank-3 gate tests membership of point (p), annotated 'see also Article 133 CRR', and a CIU's weight comes from Art. 132, so it answers NO and falls to the rank-5 (l)+(o) gate which states those classes are 'disjoint among themselves'; para 61 independently forbids the other reading, since class (o) would be empty by construction. A competing reading - that SI 2021/1078 reg. 6(3)(b)-(d) ABOLISHED Arts. 132/132a/152 from UK CRR, making the class Basel-3.1-only behind a pack Feature - was considered and rejected on the operator's ruling that the SI RELOCATED those provisions into PRA rules (its explanatory note: 'The majority of the provisions are to be replaced by rules to be made by the Prudential Regulation Authority'). That ruling is what makes this regime-blind with NO Feature. If it is ever reversed, the seam is the single class stamp. WHAT THE CHANGE IS. reporting/corep/c07.py::c07_population admitted ('standardised',) plus CCR by risk_type, while engine/classify/approach.py routes the equity class to ApproachType.EQUITY. So an entire Art. 112(1) exposure class was absent from the template: b31 C 02.00 row 0210 reported 2,500,000 RWEA with no C 07.00 sheet, validations/scope.py s0016 (bundle_keys ('equity',)) resolved sheet_not_emitted - a silent skip - and OF 07.00 memo rows 0371-0374 were structurally unpopulatable. The admission predicate is regime-blind by construction: approach == 'equity' AND equity_method not in EQUITY_IRB_METHODS, null treated as SA. Under PS1/26 every equity leg is stamped 'sa' (Art. 147A), so 'all equity under B31' and 'SA-method equity' are the same set; under CRR, COREP Annex II para 50 scopes the template to Chapter 2 of Title II Part Three - the Standardised Approach - so Art. 155(2)/(3) IRB-method equity stays correctly OUT. The estate's CRR leg is equity_method='irb_simple', so no CRR equity sheet is emitted and v4244_i continues to resolve NOT_EVALUATED / sheet_not_emitted. THE SECOND HALF IS WHY THIS IS NOT A ONE-LINER. The equity leg carried NULL for every gross-side carrier, so the population widening ALONE would have published cols 0010-0150 as 0.00 against col 0200 = 1,000,000 and col 0220 = 2,500,000 - breaking the Annex II waterfall, 0200 <= 0150, and the r0010 = sum(exposure-type rows) identity, and failing boe_b0471 (ERROR), boe_b0556 and boe_b0717. engine/aggregator/_equity_prep.py now seals exposure_type='equity' and drawn_amount=ead_final, and the three aggregator projection ladders learn the new value. exposure_type carries a NEW synthetic-producer value rather than borrowing 'loan', because analysis/recon_registry.py exposes it as a reconcilable ledger carrier and a borrowed label would assert a loan that does not exist; precedent is ccr_netting_set / ccr_default_fund / ccr_failed_trade. C 09.01 MOVED TOO, AND THAT IS REQUIRED. reporting/corep/c09.py shares c07_population, and three live BoE WARNING rules tie OF 09.01 r0150 to the OF 07.00 equity sheet cell-for-cell (boe_b0252 c0010, boe_b0253 c0075, boe_b0254 c0090). Widening only C 07.00 would have FAILED all three. Worth recording because an early simulation that patched only c07's module binding showed exactly that failure and was an artefact - c09 binds the function by name at import (LESSONS C12 mechanism 3). With both sides moved the full fix moves 8 rules and NONE to FAIL.
